content:
Maya L: Heads-up — planning a quick deploy in the noon train, target 12:30 PT. App: stream-service (feature/stream-ttl). Small config + model weights swap. Who can own smoke and rollback?
Owen T: I can take smoke. Will run the usual checklist. I'll start prepping at 12:25. @Maya L any DB migrations? :eyes:
Maya L: No DB migrations. Just config reload + weights swap. Estimate <5m for canary. Plan: canary -> 10% for 5m, then full promote if green.
Sophie R: I'll watch logs and perf. Smoke tasks I'll cover: CPU/latency, error rate, 95p latency, kvcache miss spikes. Ping me in-thread when canary flips.
Alex G: I'll hold rollback. Where's the backout script/snippets? Paste quick commands pls.
Maya L: Backout is the standard ingress-rollout. Quick snippet below:
```bash
# backout
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/stream svc=stream:previous
# flush cache
curl -sS http://ops:flush-cache
```
Jin: I'll watch dedicated pool capacity. If queue_length > 200 I will flip traffic to fallback model and signal rollback.
DeployBot: scheduled deploy job created: job/3512345678-stream-ttl-canary at 12:30 PT. Owner: Maya L
Owen T: :thumbsup: I'll post smoke pass/fail in this thread. On fail -> immediate rollback and note in deploy doc.
Sophie R: Quick smoke checklist (copied here):
- /health -> 200
- 95p latency < 300ms
- error rate < 0.5%
- sample inference consistency checks
I'll mark green/fail in thread.
Maya L: If all green by 12:40 PT I'll promote. If anything odd, rollback immediate and we'll reconvene in #eng-runtime for a quick sync.
Owen T: Ready. tagging SRE for visibility — @team-sre fyi.
DeployBot: job started at 12:30: canary -> 10% traffic. logs: https://internal/logs/3512345678
Sophie R: Smoke PASS at 12:35 — metrics stable. 95p 210ms, errors 0.12%, kvcache normal. Recommend promote.
Maya L: Promoting to 100% at 12:41. Thanks all. I'll add a short note to the release doc and close the train slot.
Alex G: Thanks team — saved us time. Will keep rollback steps on hand in case.
Jin: Verified no capacity issues during promote. All good.
Maya L: Closing: deploy finished, canary->full. Follow-up: small post-deploy check in 1hr to confirm no regressions.
